bridge.closed: The connection to HMS-CPAP closed, so this page cannot hear your bridge right now.

card.title: Bring your card
card.body: Your machine's SD card holds the nights it already recorded, and the layout your Sleep Bridge needs to know.
card.where: On a computer with CpapDash Desktop, put the card in and use Export for HMS CPAP. It saves one .cpapcard file. Choose that file here.
card.later: It goes in when setup finishes. You can take the card out of the computer now.
card.sending: Sending your card's nights and layout...
card.sent: Your card is in: its nights are being read, and your Sleep Bridge knows its layout.
card.sentNoLayout: Your card's nights are in, but its layout was not kept: {{error}}
card.sendFailed: Your card could not be sent ({{error}}). Upload it later on the Upload page.

assemble.title: Put the bridge together
assemble.cardIntoBridge: Slide the card into the Sleep Bridge.
assemble.bridgeOntoExtender: Plug the bridge into the socket end of the flat extender.
assemble.power: Plug in the USB-C power. The light comes on.
assemble.notYet: Do NOT put it in the machine yet.

connect.title: Connect the bridge to this computer
connect.body: On your phone, join the WiFi whose name starts with CpapDash-, pick your home WiFi, choose My hms-cpap, and type:
connect.askAddress: This computer's address on your home network
connect.askHint: The address you open HMS-CPAP at, for example 192.168.1.20. In Docker, use the host's address, not the container's.
connect.port: In the bridge's Port field, type {{port}}.

wait.title: Waiting for your bridge
wait.waiting: Listening for your Sleep Bridge to connect...
wait.alreadyOnline: A bridge is already connected. Is it this one?
wait.setting: Setting your bridge's folder as the source...
wait.sourceSet: HMS-CPAP now reads your nights from this bridge ({{format}} card).
wait.formatGuessed: The bridge has not recognised its card yet. If it is another machine's card, this is corrected when the machine reads it.
wait.sourceFailed: The source could not be set: {{error}}
wait.unreachable: If the bridge's own setup test says it cannot reach this computer, check that port {{port}} reaches it (in Docker, publish 8894:8894) and that no firewall blocks it.

machine.title: Into the machine
machine.intoMachine: Push the card end of the extender into your machine's SD card slot. Lay the bridge flat beside it.
machine.powerCycle: Turn the machine off and on once, while you are not using it.
machine.waiting: Waiting for your machine to read the card...
machine.seen: Your machine sees the card. You're set up.
machine.mismatch: Your machine has a different card in it than the one you brought on the first step. Put that card in the bridge, or bring this card again later.

online.title: Your nights online (optional)
online.body: Also see your nights on CpapDash? Open CpapDash, go to Settings > hms-cpap, copy the token and paste it here.
online.saveFailed: The token could not be saved.

state.notYet: Not sending yet: paste the token and press Save.
state.unreachable: CpapDash cannot be reached right now.
state.refused: CpapDash did not accept this token.
state.revoked: This token was revoked on CpapDash.
state.unavailable: Sending to CpapDash is not in this build.

bridgeSource.use: Use this bridge as my source
bridgeSource.restarting: HMS-CPAP now reads your nights from this bridge ({{format}} card). Restarting to start reading...
bridgeSource.failed: The source could not be set: {{error}}

bridges.title: Your Sleep Bridges
bridges.closed: The connection to HMS-CPAP closed, so this list may be out of date.
